commands.name: search-packages
commands.summary: Search Artifact Hub packages by keyword, with filters for kind, category, publisher, repo, org and license, plus sorting and offset paging.

commands.name: get-package
commands.summary: Get full details of a package's latest version: readme, available versions, repository, keywords, links and data.

commands.name: get-package-version
commands.summary: Get details of a specific version of a package.

commands.name: get-package-values
commands.summary: Get the default values.yaml of a Helm chart version as raw YAML text.

commands.name: get-package-templates
commands.summary: Get the template files of a Helm chart version. Each file's data field is base64-encoded.

commands.name: get-package-changelog
commands.summary: Get a package's changelog: changes per version, with timestamps and security-update flags.

commands.name: get-security-report
commands.summary: Get the Trivy vulnerability scan report for each container image of a package version.

commands.name: get-package-views
commands.summary: Get daily view counts for a package over roughly the last 30 days, grouped by version.

commands.name: get-package-stars
commands.summary: Get the number of stars a package has.

commands.name: get-package-feed
commands.summary: Get a package's release feed (RSS): versions with links and publish dates.

commands.name: random-packages
commands.summary: Get a random selection of packages, as shown on the home page.

commands.name: get-package-totals
commands.summary: Get the total number of packages and releases on Artifact Hub.

commands.name: get-site-stats
commands.summary: Get site-wide statistics: package, release, repository and organization totals and their growth over time.

commands.name: get-openapi-spec
commands.summary: Get Artifact Hub's public OpenAPI 3 specification (YAML text) describing the full /api/v1 API.
